name: LQS - Listings: search
description: Stateless read, also wired as the answer bot's only tool. In: market_id plus optional budget_min, budget_max, bedrooms, area, handover_year, developer, project_name, limit. Out: { ok, count, results }. Ordered by closest price to the budget midpoint.

parameters.query: select p.id as project_id, p.name as name, p.developer as developer, p.area as area, p.handover_quarter as handover_quarter, p.payment_plan as payment_plan, p.resale_threshold_pct as resale_threshold_pct, p.gross_yield_estimate as gross_yield_estimate, u.bedrooms as bedrooms, u.price_from as price_from, u.price_to as price_to from lqs.projects p join lqs.unit_types u on u.project_id = p.id where p.active and p.status <> 'sold_out' and ($1::uuid is null or p.market_id = $1::uuid) and ($2::numeric is null or coalesce(u.price_to, u.price_from) >= $2::numeric) and ($3::numeric is null or u.price_from <= $3::numeric) and ($4::int is null or u.bedrooms = $4::int) and ($5::text is null or p.area = $5::text) and ($6::text is null or left(p.handover_quarter, 4) = $6::text) and ($7::text is null or p.developer ilike '%' || $7::text || '%') and ($8::text is null or p.name ilike '%' || $8::text || '%') order by (case when $9::numeric is null then 0 else abs(u.price_from - $9::numeric) end) asc, u.price_from asc, p.name asc limit $10::int;
